text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 13, 2023) for 40 Beaty Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (March 13, 2023) for 40 Beaty Avenue, Folder Number: 23 122223 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 1, 2023.
